name: Jason Law
evidence: PUBLICATION ANCHOR CONFIRMED: 'The ethical imperative of algorithmic fairness in AI-enabled hiring: a critical analysis of bias, accountability, and justice' exists and is SOLE-AUTHORED by a Jason Law - AI and Ethics (Springer), DOI 10.1007/s43681-025-00927-x, verified via Semantic Scholar API (paperId f944e26fb101f4794f7e6ab88eca069612e067b3, DBLP key journals/aiethics/Law26). However Semantic Scholar returns an EMPTY affiliations array, so the paper could not be tied to WellPass Group Inc. or Calgary; link.springer.com and doi.org are blocked by the egress proxy (WebFetch EGRESS_BLOCKED, curl CONNECT tunnel 403), so the author affiliation footnote and any corresponding-author email could not be read. LINKEDIN: 'site:linkedin.com/in "Jason Law" WellPass Group Calgary' returned ten distinct namesakes (BlackSheep Environmental, Adventures Child Care Calgary, BMO Financial Group, Chateau Ridge Group, CLG Group, Google SWE, two Vancouver profiles) and NOT /in/jasonlawcomputer; '"Jason Law" "WellPass Group"' surfaced the WellPass Group Inc. company page (ca.linkedin.com/company/wellpass-group-inc) but no person page linking Jason Law to it. A search for the literal handle '"jasonlawcomputer"' returned no LinkedIn snippet; the only near-hit was jasonlaw.me, whose owner is a Carnegie Mellon MSIN student with a HKU economics/finance degree, Okta internship and Hong Kong hedge-fund background - a different person with no Calgary/WellPass/mining link, so REJECTED under the namesake rule (that site is also egress-blocked, so it could not be inspected further). Status is 'unconfirmed' rather than 'mismatch': nothing contradicts the table's URL, it simply could not be corroborated by any independent anchor. EMAIL: no address was literally printed on any page reached. github.com/jasonlawcomputer returns HTTP 404; the GitHub API is restricted to this session's configured repositories; the paper's publisher page is blocked; no personal site, lab directory or ORCID record was reachable. Per the rules no address was constructed, and the CSV's machine-generated guesses (jason.law@wellpassgroup.com etc.) were not copied. RESEARCHGATE: 'site:researchgate.net/profile "Jason Law"' returned only Jason LAWS (University of Liverpool, finance, 49 publications), Jason LAW-8 (Tufts Medical Center, Department of Pediatrics) and Jason LAWLOR (University of Cumbria) - all rejected as namesakes with unrelated affiliations and fields; a topic-scoped search ('site:researchgate.net "Jason Law" algorithmic fairness AI-enabled hiring') returned only unrelated third-party hiring-fairness papers. No ResearchGate profile for this person exists in the indexed snippets. ARXIV: the only arXiv author matching 'Jason Law' is a co-author of 2211.07357 'Controlling Commercial Cooling Systems Using Reinforcement Learning' (Google DeepMind / Trane data-centre cooling team) - unrelated to Calgary, WellPass, hiring ethics or LLM culture work, so REJECTED as a namesake. 6 WebSearch calls used.
